about_title: Creating interior design using Artificial Intelligence
about_subtitle: This project uses modern AI technologies to detect objects in images and recommend matching color palettes.
about_desc: AI Color Designer is designed to help interior designers, architects, and regular users create room designs. The program provides the ability to select colors that positively affect a person's psychological state and apply them directly to the furniture in the image.
about_feat4: Applying the selected color to the image in real-time
ai_desc: The process of automatically detecting furniture and room elements in images using the Mask R-CNN algorithm.
ai_scan_desc: The uploaded image is analyzed at the pixel level and features are extracted using deep neural networks.
ai_seg_desc: Accurate boundaries of objects such as walls, floors, tables, and sofas are defined (Bounding Box and Segmentation Mask).
ai_layer_desc: Each detected object is saved as a separate layer, allowing only that part to be painted later.
ai_try: Want to analyze your own image?
ai_try_desc: Our software can currently recognize over 80 home furnishings and architectural elements. Try it now.
color_desc: Create the perfect color harmony depending on the room's lighting, style, and purpose.
color_light_desc: Warm lighting gives a room a cozy feel, while cool lighting evokes formality and spaciousness. The program considers this when suggesting colors.
color_rule_desc: 60% dominant color (walls), 30% secondary color (furniture), 10% accent color (decorations). This golden rule enriches the design.
color_try: Shall we choose a color for your room?
color_try_desc: Upload your image, AI will automatically recommend matching colors.
mood_desc: Find out how colors affect our emotions and psychology.
mood_m1_desc: Blue and light blue tones reduce stress and help focus. Suitable for the bedroom.
mood_m2_desc: Red and orange colors stimulate appetite and encourage action. Typical for kitchens and sports rooms.
mood_m3_desc: Earth colors like yellow and brown give people a sense of comfort. Ideal for living rooms.
mood_m4_desc: Purple and green colors expand imagination and improve brain function. Suitable for workrooms.
mood_try: What mood does your home give?
mood_try_desc: Upload your image to the system, choose a target mood, and create a design using AI.
ds_desc: Get acquainted with architectural and interior design styles and decorate your home in these directions.
ds_s1_desc: Clean lines, minimalist approach, and mostly black-and-white, neutral color palette. Glass, metal, and concrete are widely used.
ds_s2_desc: Gold and evening colors, carved wooden furniture, symmetrical structure, and heavy fabrics giving a luxurious feel.
ds_s3_desc: Bright and airy rooms, natural wood textures, warm pastel tones. Main goal – simplicity and comfort.
ds_try_desc: Try targeted AI generation by selecting one of these design styles when editing your image in the program.
results_empty_desc: Upload images and change object colors. All performed actions will be saved here.
